stanzas.label: Amazing Grace, how sweet the sound
stanzas.syllables: A- maz- ing * Grace How sweet the sound That saved a * wretch like me * I, once, * was * lost But, now, * I'm * found Was blind, but, * now, I see *

stanzas.label: ’Twas grace that thought my heart to fear
stanzas.syllables: ’Twas grace that * thought my heart to fear And grace my * fears re- lieved * How pre- * cious * did that grace * ap- * pear The hour I * first be- lieved *

stanzas.label: When we've been there ten thousand years
stanzas.syllables: When we've been * there ten thou- sand years Bright shin- ing * as the sun * We've no * less * days To sing * God’s * praise Than when we'd * first be- gun *

stanzas.label: Jesus loves me this I know
stanzas.syllables: Je- sus loves me this I know For the Bi- ble tells me so Lit- tle ones to Him be- long They are weak but He is strong Yes, Je- sus loves me! Yes, Je- sus loves me! Yes Je- sus loves me For~the Bi- ble tells me so!

stanzas.label: Jesus loves me still today
stanzas.syllables: Je- sus loves me still to- day Walk- ing with me on my way Want- ing as a friend to give Light and love to all who live Yes, Je- sus loves me! Yes, Je- sus loves me! Yes Je- sus loves me For~the Bi- ble tells me so!

stanzas.label: Jesus loves me He will stay
stanzas.syllables: Je- sus loves me He will stay Close be- sides me all the way Thou has bled and died for me I will hence- forth live for Thee Yes, Je- sus loves me! Yes, Je- sus loves me! Yes Je- sus loves me For~the Bi- ble tells me so!

stanzas.label: In Christ alone my hope is found
stanzas.syllables: In Christ a- lone my hope is found He is my light, my strength, my song This cor- ner- stone, this sol- id ground Firm through the fierc- est drought and storm What heights of love, what depths of peace When fears are stilled, when striv- ings cease My com- fort- er, my all in all Here in the love of Christ I stand Oh- oh * *

stanzas.label: Here in the ground His body lay
stanzas.syllables: Here in the ground His bod- y lay Light of the world by dark- ness slain Then burst- ing forth in glo- rious day Oh,~up from the grave He rose a- gain And as He stands in vic- to- ry Sin's curse has lost its grip on me For I am His and He is mine Bought with the pre- cious blood of Christ Oh- oh * *

stanzas.label: No guilt in life, no fear in death
stanzas.syllables: No guilt in life, no fear in death This is the power of Christ in me From life's first cry to fi- nal breath Oh,~Je- sus com- mands my des- ti- ny No power of hell, no scheme of man Can ev- er pluck me from His hand 'Til He re- turns or calls me home Here in the power of Christ I'll stand * * * *

stanzas.label: O come, all ye faithful
stanzas.syllables: O come, all ye faith- ful, joy- ful and tri- um- phant! O come ye, O come * ye to Beth- * le- hem Come and be- hold Him Born the King of an- * gels O come, let us a- dore Him O come, let us a- dore Him O come, let us a- dore Him * Christ * the Lord!

stanzas.label: Sing, choirs of angels
stanzas.syllables: Sing, choirs of an- gels, sing in ex- ul- ta- tion Oh, * sing, all ye cit- i- zens of heav- en a- bove! Glo- ry to God * Glo- ry in the high- * est O come, let us a- dore Him O come, let us a- dore Him O come, let us a- dore Him * Christ * the Lord!

stanzas.label: Yes, Lord, we greet Thee
stanzas.syllables: Yes, Lord, we greet Thee, born this hap- py morn- * ing Oh, Je- sus to Thee be, * oh, glo- ry giv- en Word of the Fa- ther Now in flesh ap- pear- * ing O come, let us a- dore Him O come, let us a- dore Him O come, let us a- dore Him * Christ * the Lord!

stanzas.label: Some bright morning when this life is over
stanzas.syllables: Some bright morn- ing when this life is o- ver I'll fly a- way. To that home on God's ce- les- tial shore, * I'll fly a- way. I'll fly a- way, O glo- ry, I'll fly a- way. * When I die, hal- le- lu- jah, by and by, I'll fly a- way.

stanzas.label: When the shadows of this life have gone
stanzas.syllables: When the shad- ows of this life have gone, * I'll fly a- way. Like a bird from pris- on bars have flown, * I'll fly a- way. I'll fly a- way, O glo- ry, I'll fly a- way. * When I die, hal- le- lu- jah, by and by, I'll fly a- way.

stanzas.label: Just a few more weary days and then
stanzas.syllables: Just a few more wea- ry days and then, * I'll fly a- way. To a land where joy will ne- ver end, * I'll fly a- way. I'll fly a- way, O glo- ry, I'll fly a- way. * When I die, hal- le- lu- jah, by and by, I'll fly a- way.
